payload.prompt: Registre 15 horas para Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@example.org) en la actividad "Design" del proyecto "Rediseño web" para Viento SL (org. nº 980164454). Tarifa por hora: 1800 NOK/h. Genere una factura de proyecto al cliente basada en las horas registradas.

payload.goal: Registrar 15 horas en la actividad "Design" del proyecto "Rediseño web" para Miguel Torres y generar una factura de proyecto al cliente Viento SL basada en esas horas.
success_checks: Existe un empleado Miguel Torres con email miguel.torres@example.org
Existe un cliente Viento SL con número de organización 980164454
Existe un proyecto "Rediseño web" vinculado al cliente Viento SL
Existe la actividad de proyecto "Design" en el proyecto
Se registraron 15 horas para Miguel Torres en la actividad "Design"
La tarifa facturable del trabajo es 1800 NOK por hora
Se generó una factura de proyecto para el cliente basada en las horas registradas
La factura incluye una línea equivalente a 15 horas x 1800 NOK
risk_notes: No se indicó fecha de las horas; puede requerirse una fecha de registro para el parte de horas.
No se indicó si Miguel Torres ya existe como empleado; en sandbox vacío debe crearse primero.
No se indicó si el módulo/proceso de horas/proyecto está habilitado; puede requerir configuración previa.
No se indicó tratamiento de IVA; al no mencionarse explícitamente, la tasa de IVA es incierta.
Para facturación de proyecto puede requerirse crear pedido/base de facturación antes de emitir la factura.

line_items.description: 15 horas de actividad "Design" en el proyecto "Rediseño web"

ordered_steps: Create customer Viento SL via customer endpoint with organization number 980164454
Create employee Miguel Torres via employee endpoint with email miguel.torres@example.org
Create project "Rediseño web" linked to customer Viento SL
Create or ensure project activity "Design" exists for the project
Register timesheet entry for Miguel Torres: 15 hours on activity "Design" for project "Rediseño web"
Create order for customer Viento SL linked to project "Rediseño web"
Create order line for billable hours: 15 x 1800 NOK/h, sourced from project/time registration if supported
Create project invoice for Viento SL based on the registered hours/order line
Verify invoice totals and that the invoice references the project hours

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Find products corresponding with sent data.
Create order line. When creating several order lines, use /list for better performance.
Create invoice. Related Order and OrderLines can be created first, or included as new objects inside the Invoice.
Send invoice by ID and sendType. Optionally override email recipient.
Update invoice. The invoice is updated with payment information. The amount is in the invoice’s currency.
Find payment type corresponding with sent data.
Find employees corresponding with sent data.
Add new timesheet entry. Only one entry per employee/date/activity/project combination is supported.

rules: For bank account setup: isBankAccount=true, bankAccountNumber='12345678903', bankAccountCountry={"id": 161}.
MUST include id and version from the GET response.
When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
ALWAYS search first if product_number is provided: GET /product?number=<number> — sandbox pre-seeds products.
Only POST /product if GET returns 0 results.
Use 'number' field for the product number (NOT productNumber).
priceExcludingVat sets the base price. Also set vatType={"id": 3|5|6}.
Requires customer={"id": customer_id}.
Set orderDate and deliveryDate (use today_iso from execution_brief).
When a product was created, ALWAYS include product={"id": product_id} on the orderline.
Use unitPriceExcludingVatCurrency for the price field.
Set vatType={"id": 3} for 25%, {"id": 5} for 15%, {"id": 6} for 0%.
For multiple lines, prefer POST /order/orderline/list for efficiency.
Pass orders=[{"id": order_id}] to link order.
Set invoiceDate and invoiceDueDate.
Bank account 1920 MUST be configured first (see bank account setup pattern).
Use query parameter sendType=EMAIL.
Method is PUT, not POST.
All params are QUERY PARAMETERS: paymentDate, paymentTypeId, paidAmount or paidAmountCurrency.
Get paymentTypeId first via GET /invoice/paymentType.
Requires name and departmentNumber.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'STANDARD' unless admin is explicitly requested.
Requires customer={"id": customer_id} and projectManager={"id": employee_id}.
startDate is REQUIRED — use today_iso from execution_brief if prompt doesn't specify a date.
If the prompt mentions a project number (prosjektnummer), set number=<project_number>.
isInternal should be false unless explicitly stated as internal project.
If description text is provided, set description=<text>.
For fixed-price projects, set isFixedPrice=true and fixedprice=<amount>.
If name already exists (422 'Navnet er i bruk'), use GET /activity?name=... and reuse.
For project activities, set activityType='PROJECT_GENERAL_ACTIVITY'.
Requires project={"id": project_id} and activity={"id": activity_id}.
If activity already linked (409), ignore the error and proceed.
If a default hourly rate already exists (409 Duplicate entry), GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=... then PUT to update it.
For fixed rate: hourlyRateModel='TYPE_FIXED_HOURLY_RATE', fixedRate=<rate>.
Requires project, activity, employee, date, hours.
Only one entry per employee/date/activity/project combination.
hours is a decimal number (e.g. 8.0, 7.5).

payload.trace_example_task: Invoice with milestone/project. 9 API calls, 1 recoverable error.

payload.text:
Let me analyze this task carefully:

1. Register 15 hours for Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@example.org) on activity "Design" of project "Rediseño web" for Viento SL (org. nº 980164454)
2. Hourly rate: 1800 NOK/h
3. Generate a project invoice based on the registered hours

Let me plan the steps:

1. GET /ledger/account?number=1920 (bank account setup)
2. POST /customer (Viento SL, org 980164454)
3. GET /employee?email=miguel.torres@example.org (check if exists)


4. If the employee doesn't exist, I'll need to create a department and employee first, then set up the bank account, create the project and its design activity, configure the hourly rate at 1800 NOK, log the 15 hours in the timesheet, and finally generate an order with an order line and invoice for the customer.

Now I'm starting with the independent API calls—fetching the bank account, creating the customer, and checking if the employee exists. For the dates, I'm using today as 2026-03-21 and setting the due date to 2026-04-20. Since this is a service in Norway and VAT wasn't specified, I'll apply the standard 25% rate.

I'll analyze the task carefully:

- Register 15 hours for Miguel Torres on "Design" activity in "Rediseño web" project for Viento SL
- Hourly rate: 1800 NOK/h
- Generate project invoice based on hours
- Dates: today=2026-03-21, due=2026-04-20

Let me start with three independent calls: bank account lookup, customer creation, and employee search.
Employee Miguel Torres exists (id: 18610738). Customer Viento SL created (id: 108359506). Bank account found (id: 370680221). Now I'll configure the bank account and create the project in parallel.
Bank account configured. Project "Rediseño web" created (id: 402010952). Now I need to create the "Design" activity and set up the project hourly rate.

payload.reason: Activity 'Design' may already exist — creating a duplicate causes 422.

payload.text: Activity "Design" already exists (id: 5877802). Now I'll link it to the project and set up the hourly rate in parallel.

payload.reason: POST /project/hourlyRates will 409 if a default rate already exists. GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=X first, then PUT to update.
payload.suggestion: Call GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=<project_id> first. If results exist, use PUT to update.

payload.text: Project activity linked. Let me check existing hourly rates for the project.
A default hourly rate exists (id: 11083969) with fixedRate=0. I need to PUT to update it to 1800.
Hourly rate set to 1800 NOK. Now I'll register the timesheet entry for 15 hours and create the order simultaneously.

Timesheet entry registered (15 hours at 1800 NOK/h). Order created (id: 402011004). Now create the order line with 15 hours × 1800 NOK. VAT not specified, I'll use 25% (id: 3) as default for Norwegian services.
